event: Nala's last memory: a book on her knee at her back window, the evening blue, her eyes heavy.

memory.fact: The last thing Alan remembers is dozing over a book at his back window one evening.
The last thing Alan remembers is dozing over a book at his back window one evening.

event: She wakes half buried in hay in a cold loft, grey light between the roof boards, breath smoking.

memory.fact: Nala woke in the hay loft at Tern Hollow in the early morning of day one.

event: Her body is wrong: thin wrists, small pale freckled hands, long dark red hair full of hay.

memory.fact: Her hair is long, heavy and dark red, falling past her shoulder blades.
Her hair is long, heavy and dark red, falling past her shoulder blades.

event: Her old grey shirt hangs off her, her black tights are still on, and her small feet are bare.

make.title: Grey Shirt
make.description: A loose dark grey shirt of soft, finely knit cloth, far too big for her.

changes.note: Nala wakes wearing Alan's grey shirt

make.title: Black Tights
make.description: Snug black compression tights of a smooth, stretching weave.

changes.note: Nala wakes wearing Alan's black tights

memory.fact: She wears Alan's loose dark grey shirt, which hangs to her mid-thigh and gapes at the collar.
She wears Alan's loose dark grey shirt, which hangs to her mid-thigh and gapes at the collar.
She wears Alan's black compression tights, which still fit her snugly.
She wears Alan's black compression tights, which still fit her snugly.
She has no shoes, no money, no papers and nothing in her hands.
She has no shoes, no money, no papers and nothing in her hands.

event: Below is a stone barn: a cart with one wheel off, iron hooks on the wall, snow by the door.

memory.fact: Tern Hollow is a lone stone barn in a sheltered fold of hills, with a sagging hay loft.
Tern Hollow is a lone stone barn in a sheltered fold of hills, with a sagging hay loft.
The barn holds only a cart with one wheel off and a row of iron hooks along the wall.
The barn holds only a cart with one wheel off and a row of iron hooks along the wall.
Old snow lies in the barn's shadow, and meltwater runs in the ruts of the lane outside.
Old snow lies in the barn's shadow, and meltwater runs in the ruts of the lane outside.

event: The lane runs down to a valley of small fields and a river; white mountains climb into cloud.

memory.fact: A lane runs down from the barn to a river valley of small farms and bare fields.
A lane runs down from the barn to a river valley of small farms and bare fields.
White mountains rise along the far side of the valley, their peaks hidden in cloud.
White mountains rise along the far side of the valley, their peaks hidden in cloud.

event: Under her breastbone is a well, cold, clear, with no bottom she can see; it stirs as she breathes.

memory.fact: Under her breastbone Nala feels a deep well, cold, clear and vast, that stirs when she breathes.
Under her breastbone Nala feels a deep well, cold, clear and vast, that stirs when she breathes.
Her reservoir has no floor she can find, far deeper than any Depth's.

event: Down the lane a dog starts barking, and a man's voice tells it to hush.

memory.fact: Somewhere down the lane from the barn are a barking dog and a man who hushes it.
Somewhere down the lane from the barn are a barking dog and a man who hushes it.

event: Eyes shut, she sees a blue-green light in her chest and five bright threads running from it.

memory.fact: Eyes shut and turned inward, she sees a blue-green light in her chest and five bright threads.
Eyes shut and turned inward, she sees a blue-green light in her chest and five bright threads.
The threads run to each palm, each sole and her throat, and loop back into the well.
The threads run to each palm, each sole and her throat, and loop back into the well.

event: Something already runs along them, loop after loop, smooth and practised; she never started it.

memory.fact: The flow runs itself in loops she never chose, like a thing long practised, even as she sleeps.
The flow runs itself in loops she never chose, like a thing long practised, even as she sleeps.

event: She pushes the loops faster: warmth pours into her limbs, the cold falls back, her senses sharpen.

memory.fact: Willing the flow faster warms her limbs, sharpens her senses and makes her feel light and strong.
Willing the flow faster warms her limbs, sharpens her senses and makes her feel light and strong.
Water cycling in her makes her far stronger, quicker and tougher than her size.

event: A quarter mile off, a slow, deep voice: "Hush, Burr. It's nowt but a fox." A door shuts.

memory.fact: A man down the lane from the barn where Nala woke hushes a dog called Burr in a slow, deep voice.
A man down the lane from the barn where Nala woke hushes a dog called Burr in a slow, deep voice.

event: Turned inward, she finds the barn's iron hooks a flat, numb dead patch where all else feels alive.

memory.fact: To her inward sense the barn's iron hooks feel flat and numb, a dead patch where all else is alive.
To her inward sense the barn's iron hooks feel flat and numb, a dead patch where all else is alive.
The iron hooks along the barn wall are cold iron, hung against the Deep Children.

event: She pushes the flow into her palms; it presses to get out like a held breath, and she holds it.

memory.fact: Pushed to her palms, the flow presses to get out like a held breath, and she can hold it back.
Pushed to her palms, the flow presses to get out like a held breath, and she can hold it back.

event: She speaks: a cultivation world, maybe. Her voice comes out higher and lighter, a little husky.

memory.fact: Her voice is higher and lighter than Alan's was, a woman's voice, a little husky.
Her voice is higher and lighter than Alan's was, a woman's voice, a little husky.

event: "System? Status?" The air stays empty: no screen, no chime, no voice in her head.

memory.fact: Calling for a System or a Status brings nothing here: no screen, no voice, no answer.
Calling for a System or a Status brings nothing here: no screen, no voice, no answer.
Alan reads a lot of books, these days mostly LitRPG, and watches anime.

event: A rough grey collie pushes in through the barn door and barks once, straight up at the loft.

memory.fact: Burr, the dog of the man down the lane, is a rough grey collie.
Burr, the dog of the man down the lane, is a rough grey collie.

event: "Burr! Come by!" Footsteps crunch up the lane, uneven, one foot landing heavier.

memory.fact: The man down the lane walks unevenly, one foot landing heavier than the other.
The man down the lane walks unevenly, one foot landing heavier than the other.

event: She lets go, and the pressure slides back into her well; she drives the loops faster still.

memory.fact: Let go, the pressure held in her palms slides back up the threads into the well.
Let go, the pressure held in her palms slides back up the threads into the well.
Driving her loops fast, her heart stays slow and easy, as if she could run uphill untired.
Driving her loops fast, her heart stays slow and easy, as if she could run uphill untired.

event: A big bearded man in a sheepskin coat steps in, leaning on a crook, and follows the dog's stare.

memory.fact: Burr's man is big and bearded, forty-odd, in a sheepskin coat, leaning on a shepherd's crook.
Burr's man is big and bearded, forty-odd, in a sheepskin coat, leaning on a shepherd's crook.

event: Nala springs from the loft edge and lands ten feet down in a crouch, unjarred.

memory.fact: A drop of ten or twelve feet is nothing to her; she lands light and sure, with no jar.
A drop of ten or twelve feet is nothing to her; she lands light and sure, with no jar.
The loft floor is about ten feet above the barn's flagstones, reached by a ladder.
The loft floor is about ten feet above the barn's flagstones, reached by a ladder.

event: The man jerks back, crook up; Burr barks once, sniffs her fist, and leans his weight on her leg.

memory.fact: Burr barked once at Nala, then sniffed her fist and leaned his whole weight on her leg.
Burr barked once at Nala, then sniffed her fist and leaned his whole weight on her leg.

event: "You're Talented, then. That's Aske's barn you've been sleeping in, lass. Who are you?"

memory.fact: Seeing Nala leap from the loft unhurt, Burr's man named her Talented and gripped his crook.
Seeing Nala leap from the loft unhurt, Burr's man named her Talented and gripped his crook.
A leap from a loft landed unhurt tells Garth at once that the stranger is Talented.
The man with Burr calls the barn where Nala woke Aske's barn.
The man with Burr calls the barn where Nala woke Aske's barn.
Folk here call someone whose body does more than a body should Talented, and some are wary of it.
Folk here call someone whose body does more than a body should Talented, and some are wary of it.

event: "I'm Nala. I mean you no harm. I'm on a mission but seem to have gotten lost."

memory.fact: Alan woke in a woman's body, and in this body she calls herself Nala.
Alan woke in a woman's body, and in this body she calls herself Nala.

event: Garth Marsh, of Marsh Croft: this is Tern Hollow, and he minds the Askes' sheep while they're away.

memory.fact: Burr's man is Garth Marsh, of Marsh Croft a quarter mile down the lane.
Burr's man is Garth Marsh, of Marsh Croft a quarter mile down the lane.
Marsh Croft, Garth Marsh's place, is a quarter mile down the lane from the barn.
Marsh Croft, Garth Marsh's place, is a quarter mile down the lane from the barn.
Garth is minding the Askes' sheep and house while they are at Carrowmouth market.
Garth is minding the Askes' sheep and house while they are at Carrowmouth market.

event: "Wendlemere, lass. North side of Carrow. One of Teyr's isles." He frowns that she's never heard.

memory.fact: Wendlemere is a river valley on the north side of Carrow, one of Teyr's many isles.
Wendlemere is a river valley on the north side of Carrow, one of Teyr's many isles.
Tern Hollow is the upland barn of the Aske farm, in Wendlemere on the isle of Carrow.
Tern Hollow is the upland barn of the Aske farm, in Wendlemere on the isle of Carrow.

event: An Aspirant who lost her road, or a runaway? No boots, and snow still lies on the fells.

memory.fact: Garth takes a lost, barefoot Talented stranger for a runaway, or an Aspirant who lost her road.
Garth takes a lost, barefoot Talented stranger for a runaway, or an Aspirant who lost her road.
In the spring thaw, snow still lies on the fells above Wendlemere.
In the spring thaw, snow still lies on the fells above Wendlemere.

event: He offers porridge by his fire, but his lass is abed poorly: no Talent under his roof.

memory.fact: Garth would take a barefoot stranger in the Aske barn for a runaway, and still feed her.
Garth would take a barefoot stranger in the Aske barn for a runaway, and still feed her.
Garth has a lass at home who is abed poorly, and he wants no Talent used under his roof.
Garth has a lass at home who is abed poorly, and he wants no Talent used under his roof.

event: Nala follows him down the lane, Burr at her heel; stones sting her bare soles but do not cut.

memory.fact: Stones sting her bare soles but do not cut them.
Stones sting her bare soles but do not cut them.
The flow keeps her warm in the spring cold; her breath barely smokes where others' puffs white.
The flow keeps her warm in the spring cold; her breath barely smokes where others' puffs white.

event: Marsh Croft: a low turf-roofed cottage, a fold of ewes, a byre, iron nails on rail and door.

memory.fact: Marsh Croft is a low turf-roofed cottage with a fold and a byre, a quarter mile below the barn.
Marsh Croft is a low turf-roofed cottage with a fold and a byre, a quarter mile below the barn.
Cold iron nails are driven along the fold's top rail and over the cottage door.
Cold iron nails are driven along the fold's top rail and over the cottage door.

event: Passing under the door's nails, she feels the same flat, numb dead patch as the barn's hooks.

memory.fact: The iron nails over Marsh Croft's door feel to her as the same flat, numb dead patch.
The iron nails over Marsh Croft's door feel to her as the same flat, numb dead patch.

event: One smoky room: peat fire, table, loft ladder, box bed; peat, wet wool and a bitter poultice.

memory.fact: Marsh Croft's one smoky room holds a peat fire, a table, a loft ladder and a box bed.
Marsh Croft's one smoky room holds a peat fire, a table, a loft ladder and a box bed.
The house smells of peat smoke, wet wool and Goody Brannoc's bitter poultice.
The house smells of peat smoke, wet wool and Goody Brannoc's bitter poultice.

event: A thin, freckled girl of about nine lies flushed with fever in the box bed, watching her.

memory.fact: A thin, freckled girl of about nine lies flushed with fever in the box bed by the fire.
A thin, freckled girl of about nine lies flushed with fever in the box bed by the fire.
Wren lies in the box bed by the fire now, so her father can watch her.

event: Garth hands her hot porridge with a lick of honey and a cup of water; the cold leaves her bones.
Greymaws, Garth says: wolves big as ponies, scale in their fur, stinking of rotten salt.

memory.fact: Garth warns of greymaws: wolves big as ponies, scaled and stinking of salt, off the Whitecombs.
Garth warns of greymaws: wolves big as ponies, scaled and stinking of salt, off the Whitecombs.
Garth says the greymaws came down off the Whitecombs at midwinter.
Garth says the greymaws came down off the Whitecombs at midwinter.
Garth calls the white mountains across the valley the Whitecombs.
Garth calls the white mountains across the valley the Whitecombs.

event: Forty sheep this winter, a watchman and a carter; and wolves aren't all that came down.

memory.fact: This winter the greymaws have killed some forty sheep, a watchman and a carter.
This winter the greymaws have killed some forty sheep, a watchman and a carter.
Garth says wolves are not all that has come down off the Whitecombs this winter.
Garth says wolves are not all that has come down off the Whitecombs this winter.
Since midwinter Aberrants have come down off the Whitecombs, taking sheep and two men.
Since midwinter Aberrants have come down off the Whitecombs, taking sheep and two men.

event: They hunt at dusk and dawn and shun fire and cold iron; their prints crossed below the barn.

memory.fact: Garth says greymaws hunt at dusk and dawn, and shun fire and cold iron.
Garth says greymaws hunt at dusk and dawn, and shun fire and cold iron.
Big clawed prints, rank with rotten salt, crossed the lane below the barn two nights ago.
Big clawed prints, rank with rotten salt, crossed the lane below the barn two nights ago.
Garth found the salt-rank prints below Tern Hollow and nailed cold iron along his fold.
Garth found the salt-rank prints below Tern Hollow and nailed cold iron along his fold.

event: "Keep off deep still water after dark. Folk say the Deep Children rise and call you in."

memory.fact: Valley folk say the Deep Children rise from deep still water after dark and call people in.
Valley folk say the Deep Children rise from deep still water after dark and call people in.

event: A greymaw bit his Wren's calf at the fold a week back; Goody's poultices slow the black rot.

memory.fact: A week ago a greymaw bit Wren's leg at the fold, and the bite has gone black with rot.
A week ago a greymaw bit Wren's leg at the fold, and the bite has gone black with rot.
Goody Brannoc's poultices slow Wren's rot but cannot stop it.
Goody Brannoc's poultices slow Wren's rot but cannot stop it.
Greymaws stink of rotten salt, and their bite carries spiritual rot.
Greymaws stink of rotten salt, and their bite carries spiritual rot.

event: The girl says bravely, "It doesn't hurt much, Da." Burr flops across Nala's bare feet.

memory.fact: The feverish girl in the box bed is Wren, Garth's daughter, who calls him Da.
The feverish girl in the box bed is Wren, Garth's daughter, who calls him Da.

event: Garth doesn't hold with the Talented, but he asks: is there aught she can do for Wren?

memory.fact: Garth, who doesn't hold with the Talented, has asked Nala whether she can do aught for Wren.
Garth, who doesn't hold with the Talented, has asked Nala whether she can do aught for Wren.

event: Nala isn't certain; she'd need to visit one of the stones first, and asks how far the nearest is.
No Charterstone in Wendlemere: the nearest is at Carrowmouth, two days' walk from the Ford.

memory.fact: Wendlemere has no Charterstone; the nearest is in Carrowmouth.
Wendlemere has no Charterstone; the nearest is in Carrowmouth.
Carrowmouth is two days' walk down the valley road from Wendle Ford, one by hound cart.
Carrowmouth is two days' walk down the valley road from Wendle Ford, one by hound cart.
Carrowmouth has a Charterstone in its harbour square, lit each Threllsnacht.
Carrowmouth has a Charterstone in its harbour square, lit each Threllsnacht.
Carrowmouth lies down on the coast.
Carrowmouth lies down on the coast.
Wendle Ford, the nearest village, is three miles down the lane and along the river.
Wendle Ford, the nearest village, is three miles down the lane and along the river.

event: It gave its marks on Threllsnacht eve a fortnight gone; two Carrowmouth lads took theirs.

memory.fact: The Charterstone gave its marks on Threllsnacht eve and gives none again until next year.
The Charterstone gave its marks on Threllsnacht eve and gives none again until next year.
Two Carrowmouth lads took the Chartermark this year.
Two Carrowmouth lads took the Chartermark this year.
Threllsnacht was kept a fortnight ago, and the Carrowmouth Charterstone was lit for it.
Threllsnacht was kept a fortnight ago, and the Carrowmouth Charterstone was lit for it.

event: A stone is for Aspirants' marks, not mending. He sent to Varrow Keep a week back: no answer.

memory.fact: Garth knows a Charterstone only as where Aspirants take their marks, not as any help for rot.
Garth knows a Charterstone only as where Aspirants take their marks, not as any help for rot.
Garth sent to Varrow Keep for help for Wren and has had no answer.
Garth sent to Varrow Keep for help for Wren and has had no answer.

event: Wren sits up, eyes bright: is Nala an Aspirant from the Spires? Can she show a little magic?

memory.fact: Wren asked Nala if she is an Aspirant from the Spires, and begged to see a little magic.
Wren asked Nala if she is an Aspirant from the Spires, and begged to see a little magic.

event: Eyes shut, Nala reaches under her loops and finds a tide that pushes out and pulls back, like surf.

memory.fact: Reaching for her Talent, she feels a tide in her: a push outward and a pull back, like surf.
Reaching for her Talent, she feels a tide in her: a push outward and a pull back, like surf.

event: A name rises in her, unbidden and sure, as if always known: Undertow.

memory.fact: Its name rises in her as she reaches, unbidden and sure, as if always known: Undertow.
Its name rises in her as she reaches, unbidden and sure, as if always known: Undertow.

event: Its sense runs about ten paces out from her and stops; inside it she feels the room like a shore.

memory.fact: Its reach runs about ten paces out from her in every way, and no farther.
Its reach runs about ten paces out from her in every way, and no farther.
Undertow lets her feel Water, salt and rot within its reach, as a tide feels its shore.

event: The iron nails over the door are a dead band; the tide slides around them and won't touch them.

memory.fact: The iron nails over the door are a dead band in its reach; the tide will not touch them.
The iron nails over the door are a dead band in its reach; the tide will not touch them.
Undertow cannot move cold iron or pass through it, and cold iron feels numb to her.

event: The push wants to shove outward; the pull wants to draw in, and to draw out of what she touches.

memory.fact: The pull wants to draw things to her, and to draw something out of whatever she touches.
The pull wants to draw things to her, and to draw something out of whatever she touches.

event: In the box bed she feels Wren's leg: a sour, clotted knot of salt, and the pull leans to it.

memory.fact: Within its reach she feels Wren's leg as a sour, clotted knot of salt, and the pull wants it.
Within its reach she feels Wren's leg as a sour, clotted knot of salt, and the pull wants it.

event: Wren whispers: "Was that magic? It didn't look like anything."

memory.fact: Reaching inward for Undertow, eyes shut, she shows watchers nothing they can see.
Reaching inward for Undertow, eyes shut, she shows watchers nothing they can see.

event: Nala asks for an iron pot; Garth scrapes out the porridge pot and sets it by the box bed.
It is plain black iron, still warm; her tide slides over it, nothing like the numb nails.

memory.fact: Garth's porridge pot is plain black iron from Carrowmouth, not cold iron; the tide feels it fine.
Garth's porridge pot is plain black iron from Carrowmouth, not cold iron; the tide feels it fine.

event: Garth turns back the blanket: a swollen calf, a black bite, dark veins creeping toward the knee.

memory.fact: The greymaw bite on Wren's calf is black, and dark veins creep from it toward her knee.

event: Palm on the bite, Nala lets the pull in slowly and narrows it hard to the sour and the wrong.

memory.fact: Taking only the rot and none of Wren's own Water is a feat of care, not of strength.
Taking only the rot and none of Wren's own Water is a feat of care, not of strength.

event: Under the rot she brushes a small, still pool, asleep, like her own well in little; she spares it.

memory.fact: Under the rot, Wren holds a small, deep, sleeping pool, like Nala's own well in little.
Under the rot, Wren holds a small, deep, sleeping pool, like Nala's own well in little.

event: "It's cold," Wren whispers, shivering. Under Nala's palm the black veins ebb back to the bite.

memory.fact: Wren's rot comes out over a few minutes, the black veins ebbing back into the bite.
Wren's rot comes out over a few minutes, the black veins ebbing back into the bite.

event: After long minutes the last knot comes free; the hair on Garth's forearms stands in gooseflesh.

memory.fact: When Nala drew Wren's rot, Garth and Wren both came up in cold, prickling gooseflesh.
When Nala drew Wren's rot, Garth and Wren both came up in cold, prickling gooseflesh.
A Knack or a sleeping Talent feels the gooseflesh of her deep drawing too.

event: A mound of damp grey salt sits in her palm, reeking of rotten fish and brine.

memory.fact: Drawn out of a body, rot comes away as a grey, stinking salt on her palm.
Drawn out of a body, rot comes away as a grey, stinking salt on her palm.
Rot and salt she draws never enter her; they gather on her palm as grey, stinking salt.
Rot and salt she draws never enter her; they gather on her palm as grey, stinking salt.

event: The bite is an ordinary red wound now, the veins gone; she tips the salt into the iron pot.

memory.fact: Once Nala drew the rot out, Wren's bite was a clean red wound and her dark veins were gone.
Once Nala drew the rot out, Wren's bite was a clean red wound and her dark veins were gone.
The grey rot salt drawn from Wren lies in Garth's black iron porridge pot.
The grey rot salt drawn from Wren lies in Garth's black iron porridge pot.

event: Down in her well she feels a small, cool ebb where the work drew from her.

changes.note: Drawing Wren's rot spends a little of her well

event: Wren wriggles her toes and gasps: "Da, it doesn't hurt. It really doesn't." She is still warm.

memory.fact: With the rot drawn, Wren's leg stopped hurting, though she was still warm with fever.
With the rot drawn, Wren's leg stopped hurting, though she was still warm with fever.

event: Garth looks from the clean wound to the salt to Nala: "What in the Ancestors' name are you?"

memory.fact: Seeing Wren's rot drawn out, Garth asked Nala roughly what in the Ancestors' name she is.
